contentText: In tonight's edition, the COP31 climate summit in Turkey has failed to reach an agreement, exposing deep divisions over fossil fuels and climate finance. Also, DR Congo's Félix Tshisekedi and Kenya's William Ruto agree to restore  relations and boost regional cooperation. And determined to help their children, parents in a South African township have transformed a discarded shipping container into a sensory room.
